_description: Tier-1 file-assignment map for ARCHITAB1, modelled on the AMT PowerShell ECL skeleton (jobname -> file assignments -> Xqt). ARCHITAB1 has NO COBOL input file; input.dat is the ECL parameter card that pins the ACCEPT...FROM DATE value so the Tier-1 golden is deterministic. FICOUT (the ficout designator [fname,1,1,1]='ECL-FNAME') is materialised in the harness temp work dir.
